text:
Predicates:
Sucks(x) ::: x sucks.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Space(x) ::: x is space.
Duster(x) ::: x is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Premises:
Plungers suck. ::: Sucks(plunger).
Vacuums suck. ::: Sucks(vacuum).
Vampires suck. ::: Sucks(vampire).
Space is a vacuum. ::: Space(space) ∧ Vacuum(space). 
A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck. ::: Duster(duster) ∧ ¬Sucks(duster). 
Conclusion:
Space is a vampire. ::: Space(space) ∧ Vampire(space).
